text:
incident-bot: ALERT: increased 5xx rate on /v2/infer (service: inference-api-v2). error_rate=4.8% over 5m, latency p95 spike. Pager Level: P1. Runbook: https://r.infra/alerts/1760001234

Maya K: taking this on. oncall here. starting triage — checking pods + logs.

Maya K: quick note: traffic is still flowing but a subset of requests returning 503. adding debug logging to edge.

Javier S: saw OOM-ish traces in runtime logs earlier, maybe kv-cache growth. attaching recent stack tail:
```
[2026-02-12T02:20:11Z] runtime: kvcache: memory used 21.4GB (limit 20GB)
[2026-02-12T02:20:12Z] runtime: eviction loop stalled
[2026-02-12T02:20:13Z] http: upstream returned 503
```

Priya R: if kv-cache is the culprit we can try clear-prefix for hot keys and fall back to smaller context. Recommend: 1) enable degraded-mode (disable prefix caching) 2) flush short-lived keyspace 3) shift a small % of traffic to model-variant 'v2-lite'

Maya K: good plan. executing degraded-mode now. command: `rbctl runtime set-config inference-api-v2 degraded_mode=true`

ops-bot: runbook action logged: "degraded_mode=true" by Maya K at 1760001278

Maya K: issuing kv-cache flush for session keys: `rbctl kvcache flush --service inference-api-v2 --pattern session:* --dry-run && rbctl kvcache flush --service inference-api-v2 --pattern session:*`

Javier S: doing canary redirect of 10% -> v2-lite to reduce pressure: `trafficctl route set inference-api 10%:model=v2-lite`

Ben C: quick customer check — which tenants hit this? any paying customers affected?

Priya R: early check: affected tenants include acme-inc-prod (high traffic burst), finlytics-analytics (long sequences). Customer-facing error rate peaked ~3m ago. estimated impact window ~ 00:18 — 00:30 UTC.

Maya K: I'm posting to #incidents for visibility and notifying CS to prepare comms. Ben, can you draft a short note for customers? say we're mitigating and will follow up with postmortem.

Ben C: on it. draft: "We're aware of elevated error rates affecting inference-api-v2 between 00:18 and 00:30 UTC. Our on-call is mitigating; we'll follow up with root cause and timeline." ok to share? :thumbsup:

Ben C: (adds) flagged high-value accounts and opened support tickets for acme-inc-prod.

Eli N: I'm taking second-oncall handoff in 30m — will shadow the remainder.

Maya K: handoff: 
- status: degraded_mode=true, kv-cache flush executed, 10% traffic on v2-lite, error rate falling to 0.6%
- immediate risks: eviction recurrence if hot-key pattern persists
- next: collect heap profiles, synthetic run, create postmortem

Maya K: Eli — please confirm ownership for follow-ups after stabilization.

Eli N: confirmed. I'll own the post-incident next steps after Maya signs off.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: incident auto-marked resolved at 1760001459. 5xx rate back below threshold.

Maya K: marking incident stable. turning off canary redirect after 15m if no regression.

Priya R: quick ask — let's schedule a blameless postmortem within 48h. I can host and draft initial timeline + logs.

Maya K: suggested slot: 2026-02-13 14:00 UTC. pinging relevant folks.

Priya R: created doc: https://rb-docs/postmortems/1760001234-kv-cache-eviction (initial notes + attach logs). I've invited SRE, Runtime, CS.

Javier S: initial timeline notes in doc: memory climb -> eviction stall -> 503s -> degraded-mode -> kv flush -> canary -> stable.

Maya K: action items from triage thread, assigning now:
- AJ-1: Add explicit paging threshold to runbook: currently ambiguous. New rule: ">= 3% 5xx over 5m => L2 page; >=5% => L1". Owner: Javier S. ETA: 2026-02-20.
- AJ-2: Add kv-cache emergency flush steps to runtime runbook with exact rbctl commands and dry-run caveat. Owner: Priya R. ETA: 2026-02-18.
- AJ-3: Implement automatic synthetic check for inference-api per-customer large-sequence paths (alerts when tail latency > 95th). Owner: Eli N. ETA: 2026-03-01.
- AJ-4: Add postmortem & incident notes template to on-call playbook and mark required attendees. Owner: Maya K. ETA: 2026-02-17.
- AJ-5: Engineering task — implement KV eviction backpressure fix (prevent stall loop). Owner: runtime-team (Javier+Priya triage). Ticket: RH-7890. ETA: 2026-03-15.

Ben C: I'll add customer impact summary and list of contacted customers to the postmortem doc.

Maya K: please add runbook diff link once updated. We'll close loop when all AJ items have GH issues linked + PRs.

ops-bot: Created checklist card: https://kanban/board/incident-1760001234 (contains AJ items).

Priya R: small runbook wording suggestion: include `--dry-run` example and explicit rollback steps for trafficctl. Also add `metrics: error_rate_by_tenant` to the runbook for quick triage.

Javier S: noted. I'll update paging thresholds first then kv-cache steps.

Eli N: FYI for handoff log: I'm primary after 1760001900 until 1760044800.

Maya K: closing thread for now. Postmortem meeting scheduled and doc created. I'll ping when notes are ready for review. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Thread archived at 1760004830."
